chapter: Club Forest and the Halfway House
title: Club Forest trumpeters and Emmett Hardy's brilliance
summary: He recalls Tony Almerico, Red Bowman, and especially Emmett Hardy and his band, including Louis Armstrong's praise on the excursion boat.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles

blocks.x: well didn't Tony Amarica work with you there?

Tony Amarica worked in the band too yeah Tony played trumpet played second trumpet must have been one of his first jobs well Red Bowman played voice trumpet I don't know if you know Red Bowman just the name Raymond Burke told me about yeah well he was he was a fine trumpet man boy that's what I hear very fine trumpet man he had a band too at one time no no no he never had a band of his own that I know of but he he was a good good oh he was a good trumpet man only thing he skipped he'd be jump you know he'd jump a ball he was a good trumpet man one of the best they had around here I worked with one of the best trumpet players that ever hit this town that was Emmett Hardy I don't know if you ever heard about him I sure have you have huh Monk talks about him all the time oh yeah well Monk is a personal friend he is I worked with him and Norman Brownlee Billy Brown we had a mellophone player Billy Brown used to play mellophone Brownlee played piano Hardy played trumpet King Martin played uh bass I played trombone King Martin's brother played guitar Harry Shields played clarinet and Norman Brownlee played piano Alonzo Crumby played drums what did uh Hardy play like what did he play like he played like Louis Armstrong plays today that's what he played like at that time he really must have been something he was way ahead of everybody believe me we I remember one time we played on the boat on Canal Street on the on the excursion boat and when Louis Armstrong heard him Louis Armstrong walked over to the rail and shook his head he said that's the best I ever heard in my life he said ain't nobody gonna touch that boy when he gets a little older he was only a kid he died I think when he was 21 22 years old his picture was in the Parisian room yeah yeah they got his picture in the Parisian room my brother had a picture of him
